title: Hearty Indulgent Russian Cheddar Cheese Pasta
description: A salty, crisp, and indulgent Russian dish featuring cheddar cheese, this lacto-vegetarian-friendly pasta is a perfect comfort food for a cold winter night, made using the sous-vide method for optimal flavor and texture.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions using the sous-vide method for 30 minutes.
In a large saucepan, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the all-purpose flour and whisk together to make a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly add the milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the salt, black pepper, and garlic powder to the cheese sauce and stir to combine.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the cheese sauce, tossing to coat.
Stir in the chopped fresh dill and sour cream.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with additional fresh dill if desired.
